incident: enterprise billing double charge after regional webhook replay
invariant: one externally charged invoice per idempotency key across regions, retries, risk decisions, and telemetry

causalFinding.detail: Regional workers accepted the same billing webhook using local maps while risk and telemetry side effects escaped the shared ledger boundary.
causalFinding.requiredBoundary: atomic shared ledger reservation with payload fingerprint, scoped risk cache, retry release, and PII-safe telemetry
mustPreserve: same key with different payload is rejected
risk decisions are scoped to the full billing payload
telemetry never emits customer email or card digits
